objectives_fil: Mula sa missed-visit case, isulat ang problemang may tiyak na pangyayari, pinagmulan at impormasyong kulang, nang walang paninisi.
objectives_en: Given the missed-visit case, write a problem statement with a specific event, source and information gap, without blame.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tukuyin ang problema gamit ang pangyayari at ebidensya, hindi husga sa tao.
sections.takeaway_en: Define the problem using events and evidence rather than judgments about people.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ilarawan muna ang pangyayari at ebidensya bago pumili ng dahilan o solusyon.
sections.takeaway_en: Describe the event and evidence before choosing a cause or solution.

check.feedback_fil: Ang ikatlong sagot ay tiyak at bukas sa ebidensya. Ang poster ay solusyong hindi pa nasusuri; ang pahayag tungkol sa kagustuhan ay husga, hindi obserbasyon.
check.feedback_en: The third statement is specific and open to evidence. A poster is an untested solution; the claim about motivation is a judgment, not an observation.
